test_objective: Check that you can create a batch of entities where two have the same id

test_cases.name: 003_10_01 Create a batch of three valid entities where two have the same id
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a batch of entities where two have the same id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/create'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to '' and
 payload set to a list of entities to be created
}
